verses.text: Bless the LORD, O my soul! O LORD my God, You are very great; You are clothed with splendor and majesty,
verses.textZh: 我的心哪，你要稱頌耶和華！耶和華─我的神啊，你為至大！你以尊榮威嚴為衣服，

verses.text: Covering Yourself with light as with a cloak, Stretching out heaven like a [tent] curtain.
verses.textZh: 披上亮光，如披外袍，鋪張穹蒼，如鋪幔子，

verses.text: He lays the beams of His upper chambers in the waters; He makes the clouds His chariot; He walks upon the wings of the wind;
verses.textZh: 在水中立樓閣的棟梁，用雲彩為車輦，藉著風的翅膀而行，

verses.text: He makes the winds His messengers, Flaming fire His ministers.
verses.textZh: 以風為使者，以火燄為僕役，

verses.text: He established the earth upon its foundations, So that it will not totter forever and ever.
verses.textZh: 將地立在根基上，使地永不動搖。

verses.text: You covered it with the deep as with a garment; The waters were standing above the mountains.
verses.textZh: 你用深水遮蓋地面，猶如衣裳；諸水高過山嶺。

verses.text: At Your rebuke they fled, At the sound of Your thunder they hurried away.
verses.textZh: 你的斥責一發，水便奔逃；你的雷聲一發，水便奔流。

verses.text: The mountains rose; the valleys sank down To the place which You established for them.
verses.textZh: 諸山升上，諸谷沉下（或譯：隨山上翻，隨谷下流），歸你為他所安定之地。

verses.text: You set a boundary that they may not pass over, So that they will not return to cover the earth.
verses.textZh: 你定了界限，使水不能過去，不再轉回遮蓋地面。

verses.text: He sends forth springs in the valleys; They flow between the mountains;
verses.textZh: 耶和華使泉源湧在山谷，流在山間，

verses.text: They give drink to every beast of the field; The wild donkeys quench their thirst.
verses.textZh: 使野地的走獸有水喝，野驢得解其渴。

verses.text: Beside them the birds of the heavens dwell; They lift up [their] voices among the branches.
verses.textZh: 天上的飛鳥在水旁住宿，在樹枝上啼叫。

verses.text: He waters the mountains from His upper chambers; The earth is satisfied with the fruit of His works.
verses.textZh: 他從樓閣中澆灌山嶺；因他作為的功效，地就豐足。

verses.text: He causes the grass to grow for the cattle, And vegetation for the labor of man, So that he may bring forth food from the earth,
verses.textZh: 他使草生長，給六畜吃，使菜蔬發長，供給人用，使人從地裡能得食物，

verses.text: And wine which makes man's heart glad, So that he may make [his] face glisten with oil, And food which sustains man's heart.
verses.textZh: 又得酒能悅人心，得油能潤人面，得糧能養人心。

verses.text: The trees of the LORD drink their fill, The cedars of Lebanon which He planted,
verses.textZh: 佳美的樹木，就是利巴嫩的香柏樹，是耶和華所栽種的，都滿了汁漿。

verses.text: Where the birds build their nests, [And] the stork, whose home is the fir trees.
verses.textZh: 雀鳥在其上搭窩；至於鶴，松樹是他的房屋。

verses.text: The high mountains are for the wild goats; The cliffs are a refuge for the shephanim.
verses.textZh: 高山為野山羊的住所；巖石為沙番的藏處。

verses.text: He made the moon for the seasons; The sun knows the place of its setting.
verses.textZh: 你安置月亮為定節令；日頭自知沉落。

verses.text: You appoint darkness and it becomes night, In which all the beasts of the forest prowl about.
verses.textZh: 你造黑暗為夜，林中的百獸就都爬出來。

verses.text: The young lions roar after their prey And seek their food from God.
verses.textZh: 少壯獅子吼叫，要抓食，向神尋求食物。

verses.text: [When] the sun rises they withdraw And lie down in their dens.
verses.textZh: 日頭一出，獸便躲避，臥在洞裡。

verses.text: Man goes forth to his work And to his labor until evening.
verses.textZh: 人出去做工，勞碌直到晚上。

verses.text: O LORD, how many are Your works! In wisdom You have made them all; The earth is full of Your possessions.
verses.textZh: 耶和華啊，你所造的何其多！都是你用智慧造成的；遍地滿了你的豐富。

verses.text: There is the sea, great and broad, In which are swarms without number, Animals both small and great.
verses.textZh: 那裡有海，又大又廣；其中有無數的動物，大小活物都有。

verses.text: There the ships move along, [And] Leviathan, which You have formed to sport in it.
verses.textZh: 那裡有船行走，有你所造的鱷魚游泳在其中。

verses.text: They all wait for You To give them their food in due season.
verses.textZh: 這都仰望你按時給他食物。

verses.text: You give to them, they gather [it] up; You open Your hand, they are satisfied with good.
verses.textZh: 你給他們，他們便拾起來；你張手，他們飽得美食。

verses.text: You hide Your face, they are dismayed; You take away their spirit, they expire And return to their dust.
verses.textZh: 你掩面，他們便驚惶；你收回他們的氣，他們就死亡，歸於塵土。

verses.text: You send forth Your Spirit, they are created; And You renew the face of the ground.
verses.textZh: 你發出你的靈，他們便受造；你使地面更換為新。

verses.text: Let the glory of the LORD endure forever; Let the LORD be glad in His works;
verses.textZh: 願耶和華的榮耀存到永遠！願耶和華喜悅自己所造的！

verses.text: He looks at the earth, and it trembles; He touches the mountains, and they smoke.
verses.textZh: 他看地，地便震動；他摸山，山就冒煙。

verses.text: I will sing to the LORD as long as I live; I will sing praise to my God while I have my being.
verses.textZh: 我要一生向耶和華唱詩！我還活的時候，要向我神歌頌！

verses.text: Let my meditation be pleasing to Him; As for me, I shall be glad in the LORD.
verses.textZh: 願他以我的默念為甘甜！我要因耶和華歡喜！

verses.text: Let sinners be consumed from the earth And let the wicked be no more. Bless the LORD, O my soul. Praise the LORD!
verses.textZh: 願罪人從世上消滅！願惡人歸於無有！我的心哪，要稱頌耶和華！你們要讚美耶和華（原文是哈利路亞；下同）！
